en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a traditional half‑timbered mill building in a wooded rural setting. A fenced water channel or mill race runs in front of the house, with large trees partly obscuring the facade. The caption at the bottom reads "Gruß aus der Schiebekmühle" (Greetings from the Schiebekmühle). There is a small sign on the building and a few indistinct figures near the entrance.
